text.content: This record is the product summary for the complete, combined archive of the three AH-AIOS core domains: WorldForge, AI Harness, and AH-AIOS Core. The packages were combined into a single archive (WorldForge-AIHarness-AH-AIOS-Core-Complete.zip) on 31 October 2026. The archive delivers a set of static web assets plus the AH-AIOS backend command framework.
